statusDefinitions.verified: Exact recorded SHA has complete automated and deployed evidence.
statusDefinitions.partial: Implementation exists but required contract or deployed proof is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.blocked: The user promise cannot be truthfully released.
statusDefinitions.deprecated: No new callers are allowed and a replacement/removal gate is recorded.

entries.name: Authenticated account
entries.userPromise: Sign-in, recovery, refresh, and reauthentication preserve the user's durable account and progress.
entries.fallback: No authenticated route may persist to local-demo identity.
blockers: Exact-SHA browser recovery and reauthentication persistence evidence is not recorded.

entries.name: Onboarding
entries.userPromise: Onboarding owns starter repertoire selection and persists completion without being overwritten by defaults.
entries.fallback: Defaults initialize only a genuinely new account.
blockers: Exact-SHA returning-user browser proof is not recorded.

entries.name: Guided opening runtime
entries.userPromise: Guided opening replies come from the canonical versioned opening runtime.
entries.fallback: Missing runtime content is unavailable; it is not silently replaced by Maia or random moves.
blockers: Full exact-SHA training journey remains to be recorded.

entries.name: Maia continuation opponent
entries.userPromise: Continuation play labelled Maia invokes the approved server-side Maia model for the exact live position.
entries.fallback: Show Maia unavailable and play no substitute opponent move; never label Stockfish, runtime, random, fixture, or generic cached moves as Maia.
blockers: A real provider invocation and exact-SHA staging provenance have not been proven.

entries.name: Rewards and idempotency
entries.userPromise: A legitimate completion awards the documented points and XP exactly once to the authenticated user.
entries.fallback: Persistence failure is visible and awards nothing locally.
blockers: Independent exact-SHA before/after database proof for all three daily activities is incomplete.

entries.name: Daily rings
entries.userPromise: Tempo, Battery, and Daily Blundr update only their corresponding ring after product-defined completion.
entries.fallback: Failed, stale, abandoned, or partial attempts fill no ring.
blockers: Exact-SHA visible UI plus durable database isolation evidence is incomplete.

entries.name: Review and SRS
entries.userPromise: Review outcomes schedule the correct durable learning item without telemetry-created false records.
entries.fallback: Unavailable persistence prevents a completion rather than writing local authenticated state.
blockers: Complete deployed review-to-progress evidence is not recorded.

entries.name: Repertoire and seen lines
entries.userPromise: Starter openings and canonical openingId plus playKey seen-line coordinates persist across sessions.
entries.fallback: Missing opening content is explicit; user selection is not manufactured.
blockers: Exact-SHA browser/database persistence proof is incomplete.

entries.name: Provider game imports
entries.userPromise: Imported games are attributable, deduplicated, and create weaknesses only from verified game evidence.
entries.fallback: Provider failure is reported; it does not generate sample games or weaknesses.
blockers: Live provider QA and import-to-training evidence are incomplete.

entries.name: Procedural minigames
entries.userPromise: Enabled procedural minigames generate varied, legal, solvable, navigable positions.
entries.fallback: Generator failure returns verified content unavailable.
blockers: Exact-SHA browser coverage for every enabled family is incomplete.

entries.name: Engine-certified deep minigames
entries.userPromise: Tactic Shots, Knight Gymnasium, and King and Pawn Lab use unique server-owned multi-step lines and never leak answers before reveal.
entries.fallback: No placeholder line; return verified content unavailable.
blockers: Migration and exact-SHA browser/database proof remain required.
The original source generator was not supplied, so catalog regeneration is not reproducible.

entries.name: Opening runtime data
entries.userPromise: Training consumes one deterministic versioned 21-opening runtime package.
entries.fallback: Small Colle CSV exports are reference fixtures, not production replacements.
blockers: Canonical checksums and deterministic rounding manifest must be finalized in-repository.

entries.name: Observability and privacy
entries.userPromise: Critical failures are measurable without leaking credentials, private data, or chess answers.
entries.fallback: Telemetry failure does not alter learning, rewards, rings, or weaknesses.
blockers: Alert delivery and provider/reward/minigame operational dashboards are unproven.

entries.name: Exact-SHA release
entries.userPromise: The tested commit, immutable isolated-staging deployment, migration state, feature profile, runtime package, and rehearsed rollback identify one release candidate.
entries.fallback: Do not move the stable alias or deploy Production.
blockers: The final pushed SHA has not been deployed to the isolated blundr-staging production target.
Ten golden journeys, browser/accessibility QA, telemetry delivery, and rollback rehearsal have not yet produced one accepted exact-SHA artifact.
Release-critical registry entries must be promoted to verified only from that artifact.
